question: Who among the following athletes was conferred with the Arjuna Award, 2021 by President Ram Nath Kovind?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Arpinder Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arpinder Singh** is an Indian athlete specializing in the **triple jump**.
 
• He was conferred with the prestigious **Arjuna Award in 2021** for his outstanding achievements in athletics.
 
• Arpinder Singh has represented India in several international events and won the **gold medal at the 2018 Asian Games** held in Jakarta, Indonesia.
 
• He became the first Indian to win a gold medal in the triple jump event at the Asian Games in **48 years**.
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is one of the highest civilian honors given in the field of sports in India, recognizing exceptional performance at the international level.
 
• Arpinder's performance has been instrumental in bringing attention to **field events** in Indian athletics, which historically has been dominated by track events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dutee Chand**__

 __
 
• **Dutee Chand** is an Indian sprinter specializing in the **100m and 200m races**.
 
• She is the **first Indian athlete** to openly come out as a member of the **LGBTQ+ community**.
 
• Dutee won **silver medals** in the 100m and 200m events at the **2018 Asian Games**.
 
 
 
• **Tajinder Pal Singh Toor**__
 __
 
• **Tajinder Pal Singh Toor** is an Indian athlete who competes in the **shot put** event.
 
• He won a **gold medal** at the **2018 Asian Games**, setting a new **Games record** with a throw of **20.75 meters**.
 
• He also holds the **national record** in shot put.
 
 
 
• **Swapna Barman**__
 
 
• **Swapna Barman** is an Indian athlete who specializes in the **heptathlon**.
 
• She made history by becoming the **first Indian heptathlete** to win a gold medal at the **Asian Games (2018)**.
 
• Swapna is known for her unique physical condition of having **six toes on each foot**, which adds to her challenges as an athlete.
